title: Apple updates guidelines to ban nudify apps masquerading as regular apps to pass review
snippet: Apple said that it will ban AI apps that don't moderate offensive content.

title: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares
snippet: That's more than $10 billion in shares, or around 1% of Musk's current net worth.

title: Khosla Ventures doubles down on Even Healthcare to challenge India’s hospital economics
snippet: Even Healthcare reaches a $300 million valuation in a Khosla Ventures-led round as it plans to expand its hospital network in India.
